主要内容: Southern Company subsidiary Southern Power has completed the issuance of $1 billion in Green Bonds, becoming the first investment-grade U.S. utility to offer this type of security. The bonds will fund eligible renewable energy projects, including solar and wind facilities in the U.S. Southern Power has developed a green energy portfolio with approximately 1,550 MW of generating capacity through 21 solar and wind projects. The Southern Company system has added or announced over 3,600 MW of renewable projects since 2012. The company has committed $20 billion to developing low- and zero-carbon emission resources. Southern Power, a subsidiary of Southern Company, is a leading U.S. wholesale energy provider with over 10,200 MW of generating capacity across nine states. Southern Company, based in Atlanta, serves more than 4.5 million customers with 46,000 MW of generating capacity. The company is a leader in clean, safe, and affordable electricity and is committed to innovation in energy resources.
